Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Should always be "FIX.4.2". Cboe FI Drop Copy uses FIX 4.2.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: See Supported Message Type section for accepted message types.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence numbers reset to '1' at the start of each trading day.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Used to indicate a possible retransmission of the sequence number.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Used to indicate a possible retransmission of the message under a new sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT Date/Time message was sent. The value should ideally contain milliseconds. It must be within 2 minutes of the Cboe FI system time to not be rejected. The Cboe FI FIX Gateway uses PTP time synchronization. It is strongly recommended the sender use either PTP or NTP time synchronization.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Integer byte count of message length without the CheckSum field. Follows FIX protocol standard.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Cboe FI username.

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Cboe FI password.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Always 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Client heartbeat interval, expressed in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates the intention to reset sequence numbers on both sides of the connection. Setting this field will prevent resequencing from occurring. Client Logon messages with 141=Y are HIGHLY discouraged other than on initial daily logon. The reason is that it's possible for messages to be sent to but never received by a client during a network outage. If, in this scenario, a client resequences correctly on logon, they will be resent the missed messages. However, if the client's logon message contains 141=Y, resequencing will not occur, and the missed messages will not be sent.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Always 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Client heartbeat interval, expressed in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Echoed value from the Logon message sent by clients. Not set if a client does not set the field in their Logon message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Only included if Heartbeat is in response to a Test Request.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: 0 indicates +infinity. In response to a Resend Request, Cboe FI will only respond to clients with trades. On resent trades, Cboe FI does not use the PossDupFlag Tag (Tag 43).

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Next expected sequence number.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Valid values are 'Y' or 'N'. The use of 'Y' is required for common resequencing. 'N' is not recommended, and should only be used in emergency situations that require manual intervention. 'N' causes the SeqNo of the SequenceReset message to be ignored, creating a high possibility of message loss.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Freeform text to indicate the reason for the logout.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Alphanumeric text field meant to contain 3rd-party account ID. This will only be populated if sent in the Account Tag (Tag 1) on a New Order Single message.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client-generated Order ID. For takers the field contains the ClOrdID (Tag 11) from the New Order Single message (35=D). For makers, the field contains the QuoteID field (Tag 117) concatenated with the QuoteEntryID field (Tag 299) of the Quote message (35=S). For trades not directly initiated by the client (manual adjustment trades, for example) the field may be set to 0.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Cboe FI Execution ID. Execution IDs for Cboe FI are indefinitely unique and never reused. The Execution ID field is only composed of alphanumeric characters and underscores.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Always 0.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Exchange Generated OrderID.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Always 2 (Filled).

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Always 2.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Value will always be 0 regardless of the TimeInForce on the original order.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Always 'USD'.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy. 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: SettlementDate
Field.Description: Settlement date of the trade in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Trade date in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The symbol for the Treasury instrument. Refer to the symbology section of the spec for example Cboe FI symbology.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Always 1.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: CUSIP for the instrument.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Y = Indicates aggressive trade (Liquidity Consumers Only). N = Indicates passive trade (Liquidty Providers Only). CBOEUST = Otherwise (manually entered trade).

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: OrderQty (Tag 38) - CumQty (Tag 14). Nowithstanding the above, any remaining quantity of a Market Maker quote will be automatically removed from the orderbook.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Always F (Trade).

Field.Name: AccountID
Field.Description: Account responsible for the trade. (Cboe FI custom tag.)

Field.Name: SessionID
Field.Description: Session responsible for the trade. (Cboe FI custom tag.)

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Executed quantity.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Executed price.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: The Broker ID (3-digit identifier) of the contra party on this fill. This tag is present if (and only if)Ord Statusis 2 (filled). Note: this is a standalone tag and is not used in conjunction with the No Contra Brokers(Tag 382) repeating group.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades on attributed orders. Always 1 if present.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Executed quantity.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Executed price.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: The Broker ID (3-digit identifier) of the contra party on this fill. This tag is present if (and only if)Ord Statusis 2 (filled). Note: this is a standalone tag and is not used in conjunction with the No Contra Brokers(Tag 382) repeating group.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades on attributed orders. Always 1 if present.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order being cancelled or replaced (for a solicited , or , Order Cancel Cancel/Replace otherwise not present).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Freeform string text.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order being cancelled or replaced (for a solicited , or , Order Cancel Cancel/Replace otherwise not present).

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Only used when Exec Type is Rejected (8). 0 = Exchange option 1 = Unknown symbol 2 = Exchange closed 3 = Order exceeds limit 5 = Unknown order 6 = Duplicate order 8 = Stale order

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Freeform string text.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Only present when 150=D. 1 = GTC/GTD renewal / restatement (no corporate action) 4 = Iceberg display size refreshed 5 = Partial Reduce due self-match trade prevention result based on No Trade Feat (7713) C = Confirmed closing price for MOC trade R = Replaced by another port (i.e. Purge-Amend Port).

Value.Description: SeqNo of the SequenceReset message is ignored. Emergency-only use.
Reset sequence numbers on both sides of the connection.
